passages.text: The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the federal securities laws and should be read in conjunction with the disclosures we make concerning risks and other factors that may affect our business and operating results. You should read this information in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and the notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data , of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. See also “Forward-Looking Statements” immediately prior to Part I, Item 1, Business , of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our Company We are a leading developer, manufacturer, and provider of data storage devices and solutions based on HDD technology. HDDs are critical components of the global data infrastructure market and play an essential role in enabling the AI-driven data economy. They provide reliable, cost-effective, high-capacity storage for a broad range of applications, including cloud data centers, enterprise storage systems, edge computing, smart video, client and consumer devices. Our broad portfolio of technology and products, sold under the Western Digital® and WD® brands, addresses our customers’ storage needs through multiple end markets: “Cloud,” “Client” and “Consumer”. Cloud is our largest and fastest growing end market comprised primarily of products for public or private cloud environments and enterprise customers. Through the Client end market, we provide our OEM and channel customers a broad array of high-performance HDD solutions across desktop and notebooks. The Consumer end market offers a comprehensive portfolio of HDD external storage products that we offer globally through our retail and channel partners. Our fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest to June 30 and typically consists of 52 weeks. Approximately every five to six years, we report a 53-week fiscal year to align the fiscal year with the foregoing policy. Fiscal year 2026, which ended on July 3, 2026, comprised 53 weeks, with the first quarter consisting of 14 weeks and the remaining quarters consisting of 13 weeks. Fiscal years 2025 and 2024, which ended on June 27, 2025 and June 28, 2024, respectively, each comprised 52 weeks, with all quarters presented consisting of 13 weeks. 32 Table of Contents Key Developments Market Conditions and Outlook The increasing long-term demand for data storage in the cloud is benefiting our HDD business. The adoption of AI and workloads driven by hybrid data are propelling growth in data storage as well. This creates an accelerated demand for higher-capacity drives, which have greater manufacturing complexity and longer production lead times. In response, customers are partnering with us earlier to support their future growth requirements and are extending the duration of their commercial arrangements, which improves our long-term visibility of demand. credit_strengths.text: Western Digital's operating cash flow and free cash flow comfortably exceed reported debt, with free cash flow covering debt multiple times over. This cash generation, paired with a cash balance exceeding borrowings, produces a net cash position and places leverage well below the Information Technology sector median, supporting a minimal indicative financial risk profile.

Operating income and revenue have grown sharply across the annual trend, lifting the operating margin above the sector median and driving interest coverage far above sector norms. The HDD business, positioned in the AI-driven cloud data economy, is generating materially stronger earnings than the prior fiscal year.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses that convertible notes remain outstanding and holders retain conversion rights tied to a conditional conversion feature, with a portion already tendered. This creates potential equity dilution or cash settlement needs, and the remaining principal could convert or require refinancing, adding uncertainty to the capital structure.

A material portion of cash and cash equivalents is held outside the United States, per the liquidity disclosure. While no material tax consequences were unaccrued, offshore concentration could constrain timely debt service or shareholder returns if repatriation frictions or funding mismatches arise.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is exceptionally strong, with operating income covering interest expense many times over, well above the sector median. Free cash flow to debt also exceeds sector norms, indicating ample capacity to service obligations from internally generated funds without reliance on external financing.

The maturity profile shows debt including interest due within one year, but cash on hand exceeds total borrowings, and the company has demonstrated debt reduction through exchanges and repayments. Liquidity is further supported by a current ratio above one, though below the sector median.

overall_credit_view.text: Western Digital presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net cash, strong coverage and free cash flow well above sector medians. The sharp reduction in debt and improving operating trend support a stable credit trajectory, though the convertible notes and offshore cash mix warrant monitoring.

Shareholder distributions, particularly buybacks, absorb a significant share of free cash flow, which could limit deleveraging or liquidity build if earnings decline. Nonetheless, the net cash position and sector-leading cash conversion provide a strong buffer against cyclical HDD demand and refinancing risk.

credit_strengths.text: Western Digital的營運現金流及自由現金流均遠超報告債務，自由現金流足以覆蓋債務數倍。此現金產生能力，加上現金結餘超過借款，形成淨現金狀況，並使槓桿遠低於資訊科技行業中位數，支持最低的指示性財務風險狀況。
營運收入及收益在年度趨勢中大幅增長，將營運利潤率提升至行業中位數以上，並推動利息覆蓋率遠高於行業常規。HDD業務定位於人工智能驅動的雲端數據經濟，所產生的盈利較上一財政年度顯著增強。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露，可換股票據仍未償還，持有人保留與有條件轉換特徵掛鈎的轉換權，其中一部分已提交。這造成潛在的股權攤薄或現金結算需求，而剩餘本金可能轉換或需要再融資，增加資本結構的不確定性。
根據流動性披露，現金及現金等價物的重大部分持有於美國境外。雖然並無重大稅務後果未計提，但離岸集中可能限制及時償債或股東回報，若出現匯回摩擦或資金錯配。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率異常強勁，營運收入覆蓋利息支出多倍，遠高於行業中位數。自由現金流對債務比率亦超過行業常規，表明有充足能力以內部產生資金償付債務，無需依賴外部融資。
到期情況顯示債務包括一年內到期的利息，但手頭現金超過總借款，且公司已通過交換及還款展示債務減少。流動性進一步由流動比率高於一支持，儘管低於行業中位數。

overall_credit_view.text: Western Digital呈現最低的指示性財務風險狀況，淨現金、強勁覆蓋率及自由現金流均遠高於行業中位數。債務大幅減少及營運趨勢改善支持穩定的信貸軌跡，儘管可換股票據及離岸現金組合值得監察。
股東分派，尤其是回購，佔自由現金流的重大份額，若盈利下降，可能限制去槓桿或流動性積累。儘管如此，淨現金狀況及行業領先的現金轉換提供強大緩衝，抵禦週期性HDD需求及再融資風險。
